content.label:
This is sincerely the best thing ever and I love it. It's very convenient and comfortable but I have some issues with it.
- It keeps the microphone kind of live at all times, which is a bit of a battery drain and a privacy situation that I don't like.
- It keeps jumping into the app always, back and forth and back and forth and back and forth, instead of just being a keyboard of its own, and it's trying to get your attention. It's like, "Oh you have a stat. Here's how many days you've been using it. Here's what..." It's like it doesn't know whether it wants to be an app or a keyboard.
- The main issue is the price. I would have paid, I feel like, maybe $40, maybe even $50, to get this keyboard. I absolutely will not pay a yearly fee of $150 or $15 per month just to have a keyboard that is only slightly better than the dictation I already have on the regular Apple keyboard and the Siri AI and stuff. It's just not an expense that I can justify and that just saddens me because I would have paid for it. I would say that $40 or something is a lot of money to pay for something that is just a keyboard. Even if it is the most amazing and complicated keyboard in the world, it doesn't make sense to me.
